settings.tag_help: A new list can start a discussion where people comment on it. It starts in this tag. Without a tag, only members who may skip tag requirements can start one.
settings.max_items_help: Up to 500. Bigger lists take longer to rank, especially on phones.

permissions.create: Make, remix and like tier lists
permissions.moderate: Edit and delete anyone's tier lists

index.title: Tier lists
index.meta: Rank anything from S to F, remix other members' lists, and see where the crowd puts every item.
index.lead: Rank anything from best to worst. Remix anyone's list and see where the crowd puts each item.
index.by_author: Every list this member has made or remixed.

editor.add_placeholder: Type an item, or paste a list
editor.add_help: Drag pictures here, or paste one. Paste several lines to add an item for each.
editor.full: This list has {max} items, the most it can hold.

editor.share_remix: Post it in the original's discussion
editor.share_remix_help: Your remix shows up as a reply.
editor.keyboard_help: Press Space to pick up an item, the arrow keys to move it, and Space again to drop it. Escape puts it back. Press M for a menu.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.bad_title: Give your list a title (up to 100 characters).
errors.bad_description: The description can be up to 1,000 characters.
errors.bad_tiers: Every row needs a name (up to 24 characters). A list has 2 to 10 rows.
errors.bad_items: One of the items isn't valid. Each needs a name or a picture.
errors.too_many_items: A list can hold up to {max} items.
errors.slow_down: You're doing that too often. Please wait a moment.
errors.discussion_denied: Your list is saved, but you can't post a discussion for it.
errors.discussion_needs_tag: Your list is saved, but discussions need a tag. Ask an admin to choose one for tier lists.
errors.discussion_failed: Your list is saved, but its discussion couldn't be posted.
errors.no_discussion: Your remix is saved. The original has no discussion to post it in.
errors.has_discussion: This list already has a discussion.
